[ "$1 $2" = "fast-checks --owned-worktree" ] || exit 9
head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
common=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)
mkdir -p "$common/plangraph-state/fast-checks"
text=$(printf 'head %s\nresult green\ncheck fake-fast-checks rc=0 wall=0.100\n' "$head")
printf '%s\n' "$text" > "$common/plangraph-state/fast-checks/$head"
blob=$(printf '%s\n' "$text" | git hash-object -w --stdin)
tree=$(printf '100644 blob %s\t%s\n' "$blob" "$head" | git mktree)
commit=$(GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=plangraph GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=plangraph@localhost GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=plangraph GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=plangraph@localhost git commit-tree "$tree" -m "fast-checks receipt")
git update-ref "refs/plangraph/receipts/$head" "$commit"
